summary.intent: Bootstrap the newly configured release-please system with correct tags to eliminate changelog bloat on PR #427, align api-client versions with the API, and validate the release pipeline with a small feature (expose API version on /health endpoint).
summary.outcome: All 15 bootstrap tags created and pushed, api-client versions aligned to 0.35.0, OpenAPI version made dynamic, /health endpoint now returns version field, release preview CI fixed to skip merge commits, and PRs #428 and #429 merged.

repo: release-please treats the entire commit history as unreleased when no prior tags exist — bootstrap tags on a specific SHA are required to establish a starting point.

HealthController is excluded from the NestJS OpenAPI generator module due to TypeORM dependency requiring a real DB; the health endpoint spec is defined manually in apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts around line 237.
Commit type prefix (fix: vs chore:) directly triggers release-please version bumps — using fix: for CI/tooling changes causes unwanted patch bumps across packages.
The web and desktop apps were decided to use monotonic major.minor versioning in phase 41 discussion, but semver was implemented anyway; this was deferred as acceptable for now.
pnpm api:generate produces formatting churn in openapi.json (compact arrays → expanded multi-line) when the generate script changes, even without functional spec changes.

code.finding: Controllers list for OpenAPI generation excludes HealthController; manual health spec defined around line 237-264 instead.
npm_package_version env var is unreliable; fixed to fail fast if missing, with fallback to reading package.json directly in main.ts.
OpenAPI version now reads from process.env.npm_package_version with fs.readFileSync package.json fallback instead of hardcoded '0.1.0'.
Merge commits (2+ parents) were not filtered before conventional commit parsing, causing false version bump labels across packages. Fixed by skipping commits with parents.length >= 2.
Extra files in release-please config require jsonpath notation for nested JSON fields (e.g., openapi.json's info.version) — a plain file path only works for root-level version fields.

workflow: Force-pushing to rewrite commit messages requires care: soft reset to parent, restage, recommit, then force push — not git commit --amend which could corrupt history.
When cargo update pulls in unrelated dependency changes, use targeted workspace-only lock update to avoid noise: cargo update --workspace.
Resolving GitHub review threads requires two API calls: REST reply to the comment ID, then GraphQL mutation on the thread ID to mark resolved.
GSD quick tasks interrupted mid-executor can be executed manually by reading the PLAN.md and implementing directly — useful when needing custom commit message scopes.

friction: Cargo.lock regeneration via cargo update pulled in a large number of unrelated external dependency updates — required manual targeted update instead.
Auto-merge was believed to be enabled on PR #428 but autoMergeRequest was null — required manual merge.
npm_package_version env var is unreliable at script runtime, causing CodeRabbit/Copilot review flags and requiring a fallback implementation.
GSD executor was spawned with a worktree but user needed a custom commit message scope (feat(api): instead of generic); required interrupting and executing manually.
openapi.json JSON serialization format changed (compact to expanded arrays) after script changes, creating formatting churn unrelated to spec content changes.
open_items: Monotonic (major.minor) versioning for web and desktop apps was the original phase 41 decision but semver is currently in use — deferred as acceptable for now.
PR #427 (release-please) needs to be verified to confirm it regenerated with a clean, minimal changelog after bootstrap tags were pushed.
The openapi.json formatting churn issue (compact vs expanded array serialization) was not resolved — may produce noise in future diffs.
